statements.quote: For instance, Li doping, either chemically or electrochemically, results in the transformation of spinel oxides to rocksalt structures. The thin‐film deposition was carried out at an optimal O2 flow, which is similar to or higher than what has been used for depositing conventional spinel oxides with similar constituents. Furthermore, post‐annealing treatment of the deposited thin films in an air atmosphere (at 700 °C for 6 h) was performed to see if the rocksalt‐HEO phase disappears.

In any case, it seems like the spinel of (Co0.2Cr0.2Fe0.2Mn0.2Ni0.2)3O4 composition is an interesting system that in bulk shows a strong preferential occupation while in thin films displays a lattice‐coherent phase dissociation.
